articles.title: Securitize builds Wall Street credentials with SEC adviser license as tokenization expands
articles.snippet: The license broadens the BlackRock tokenization partner's offering as regulators weigh rules for onchain investment products.

articles.title: Crypto steadies as Iran-U.S. pause sends oil tumbling, lifts risk assets
articles.snippet: Brent crude plunged 7% after the U.S. and Iran paused Strait of Hormuz strikes, lifting equities and DeFi tokens while bitcoin held near $65,000 ahead of a pivotal Fed decision Wednesday.

articles.title: Nvidia, Microsoft and IBM Launch Open Secure AI Alliance to Strengthen AI Cybersecurity
articles.snippet: More than 40 technology companies and organizations have allied to develop open-source AI security tools and standards for cyber defense.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs Shed $465M Over Two Days, Led by BlackRock's IBIT
articles.snippet: The selling reversed a seven-day, $1 billion inflow streak, with analysts blaming renewed U.S.-Iran tensions and Fed rate-hike fears.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs Shed $225M, Snapping Seven-Day Inflow Streak as Iran Tensions Spook Markets
articles.snippet: BlackRock's IBIT led the exit as Bitcoin briefly dipped under $65,000 and stocks fell on renewed US-Iran hostilities—though the week still closed in the green.
